worldcombat.skill.faketears.summary: Feign tears in front of a foe to make it soften and drop its Sp. Def. The tears must be seen, so the range is short and line of sight matters; the target need not be looking at you; the more cherished the caster, the more convincing the act.
worldcombat.skill.faketears.use.0: Strip the Sp. Def of a special attacker up close
worldcombat.skill.faketears.use.1: Open a gap for a teammate's special attack
worldcombat.skill.faketears.use.2: Feign tears at a range where the target cannot break line of sight
On a hit the target loses %1$s stages of Sp. Def, and that drop does not recover when the fluster ends - it lasts until combat breaks or its stages are reset. The target is also left with a fluster marker for about %2$s; the marker itself changes neither stats nor actions and only stops repeated feints.
The feint only carries within %1$s blocks and needs a clear line of sight; the target need not be facing you, and a hit does not pin it in place.
worldcombat.skill.faketears.timing: Range %1$s blocks, telegraph %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.faketears.preference.a: Only consider the feint when a threat is within this distance; smaller keeps it to grappling range, larger chases targets down.
On: the companion will leave a hold position to deliver the feint.
